longBio: I'm an engineer by training and a performance nerd by heart. I'm a big fan of creating products that are both fast and useful, and I take pride in my work. When I'm not coding, I like to sketch design systems and profile bundles.

I'm also a big fan of learning new things, and I'm always looking for ways to improve my craft. I'm currently exploring AI-integrated UX and LLM tooling, and I'm always excited to meet new people and collaborate on new projects.

description: Led end-to-end migration of the entire web platform from.NET & jQuery to Next.js and React, reducing page load times by 40% and enabling a modular, component-driven frontend architecture
Engineered a CMS-driven marketing page system supporting 35+ campaign variants, cutting rollout time by 60% and increasing lead form submission rates from 8% to 20%
Optimised Core Web Vitals and page performance, pushing Google PageSpeed scores from 50 to 90+, directly lowering paid marketing spend by 30% through improved ad quality scores
Implemented scalable on-page SEO strategy (meta tags, structured schema, keyword targeting), scaling organic traffic from 5K to 25K daily visitors and driving 3M+ quarterly users
Integrated Razorpay payment gateway end-to-end, driving a 20% uplift in Premium plan conversions through faster, more reliable checkout experience
Established frontend code review standards and enforced DRY principles across the team, reducing code redundancy by 15% and improving sprint velocity by 10%

Architected and executed A/B testing infrastructure using Firebase and Google Tag Manager for DOM-level experiments on landing pages and CTAs, directly informing conversion rate optimisation decisions

Built a multi-flow conversational chatbot handling appointment booking, doctor discovery, and real-time consultation improving self-serve appointment booking completion and reducing dependency on manual support channels
